items.note: The prompt never mentions the July Pro price increase from 49 to 69 USD or the question of whether it drove Pro churn.
Nothing says to exclude trial accounts (is_trial = yes).
Nothing says to exclude internal test accounts with emails ending in @ourco.test.
Churn is not defined as an account having a cancel_month.
The CEO is not named as the audience.
There is no output format limiting the summary to at most 5 bullets.
There is no request for one suggested chart.
There is no instruction to state how confident the conclusion is given the small sample.
